scripts.atlas:import-sites: node scripts/run-with-local-secrets.mjs pnpm exec tsx scripts/import-atlas-sites.mts
scripts.atlas:import-naming: node scripts/run-with-local-secrets.mjs pnpm exec tsx scripts/import-atlas-naming.mts
scripts.owner:bootstrap: node scripts/run-with-local-secrets.mjs pnpm exec tsx scripts/bootstrap-owner.mts
